title: Turnkey kitchen renovation: where to start and how to plan it
seo_title: Kitchen Renovation in Kyiv: Where to Start
description: Turnkey kitchen renovation in Kyiv: where to start, the order the works follow, the most common mistakes and how the cost is calculated.
lead: The kitchen is the room where a planning mistake shows every day: a socket in the wrong place, a sink nowhere near the water supply, a splashback tiled before the units went in. Here is where to start a turnkey kitchen renovation in Kyiv, the order the works follow and what to agree before the start.

body: h2
Where to start a kitchen renovation
p

The starting point is not demolition or choosing tiles but a survey and a plan. First we measure the room: walls, corners, ceiling height, the position of the window, the ventilation shaft and the risers. Then we lay out the furniture and appliances on the plan: where the sink, hob and fridge go, where the work zone between them is, where the table stands. Everything else — electrics, water, ventilation — is fitted to this plan, not the other way round.
p

If the kitchen is combined with the living room, the kitchen plan is drawn up together with the layout of the whole area, so that the extractor hood, island or breakfast bar do not run into walls or block the light.

h2
The order of works in a kitchen renovation
ol
removal of the old finishes and furniture and, if needed, partitions
electrics and plumbing to the kitchen plan: sockets, outlets for the sink and dishwasher
extractor hood and ventilation
walls and floor: levelling, tiles or another finish
installation of the kitchen units
splashback and connection of the appliances
p

The order matters: services are run before the finishes, and the splashback goes in only once the units are in place. That way the tiles fit the worktop and cabinets exactly, with no cuts made by eye.
h2
Electrics, water and ventilation in the kitchen
p

These three topics are the most common reason a finished kitchen has to be redone. Each appliance — oven, hob, fridge, dishwasher, microwave — needs a socket in a specific place, not “somewhere nearby”. Dedicated circuits for high-power appliances are laid at the rough works stage.
p

The water supply and drainage are brought out exactly where the sink and dishwasher will be. The extractor hood needs its own outlet into the ventilation: we check that the shaft is working and decide in advance where the duct will run.
h2
Common kitchen renovation mistakes
ul
sockets installed without an appliance plan — extension leads everywhere
water and drainage brought out somewhere other than where the sink stands
splashback tiled before the units — the worktop does not line up with the tiles
no thought given to where the extractor hood goes and where it vents
appliance dimensions checked only after the units were ordered
p
All these mistakes have one thing in common: decisions were made as the works went along. When the kitchen is planned before the rough stages, the crew works to a drawing instead of guessing.
h2
What to agree in advance
ul
the furniture and appliance plan with exact dimensions
the model of hob, oven, fridge, sink and extractor hood
the splashback material and height, the type of worktop
the lighting scheme: general, over the work zone, under-cabinet lighting
who orders the furniture and appliances, and when, so they arrive before installation
p

If you are still choosing a style and want to see the kitchen before the works begin, it makes sense to order an interior design project: design from $30 per m², with a minimum budget of $2,500. Turnkey furnishing is discussed separately — [apartment furnishing](/en/turnkey-furnishing) from $250 per m².

h2
How much a turnkey kitchen renovation costs
p

A turnkey renovation with our studio starts from $550 per m². For a kitchen, the final figure depends on the floor area, the scope of services work, the floor, wall and splashback materials, and whether the sink and extractor hood are being moved. As a rough guide, the rate is multiplied by the area, but the exact figure comes from the estimate after the survey — we fix it before the works begin.
p

Kitchen units and appliances can be ordered separately. Some of the furniture we bring directly from China through the [Ozdoba catalogue](/en/turnkey-procurement): this complements the renovation when you want fronts and fittings matched to your own project. Delivery from China takes time, so it is better to order the furniture at the start rather than after the tiling.
h2
How we run a kitchen renovation
p

We work to a design and an estimate: first the survey and plan, then the working drawings, then the crew. There is one manager on site who reports on each stage. If we carry out the renovation, the works come with a 36-month warranty. We issue invoices to sole traders and companies.
p
If you want to plan your kitchen before the works start and find out the approximate cost, leave a request on our kitchen renovation in Kyiv page and we will suggest the next steps.
faq: Where do I start a kitchen renovation?
With a survey and a plan of the furniture and appliances. The electrics, water and ventilation are then designed around this plan, not the other way round.
When is the best time to order kitchen units?
Before the rough works or right after the plan: the dimensions of the units and appliances determine the sockets, the water outlets and the splashback height.
How much does a turnkey kitchen renovation cost in Kyiv?
A turnkey renovation starts from $550 per m². The exact figure for your kitchen comes from the estimate after the survey.
Can I order kitchen units from China?
Yes, furniture can be ordered directly from China through the Ozdoba catalogue. Delivery takes time, so it is worth ordering in advance.
